scope: Every SSD product page on consistent.in (internal; no portable/external SSD exists on the site).

method.requests: Plain curl, default settings (no user-agent override), about 1.5 s apart. Python urllib image requests got HTTP 403 from Cloudflare and were not used further. 4 image requests got a bot-verification page ("One moment, please... Please wait while your request is being verified..."); one later plain retry of those 4 succeeded.
notFetched: amazon.in / amzn.to / flipkart.com (search URLs built locally)
shop.consistent.in (official store linked by Buy Now; outside allowed hosts)
method.imageText: Text in images was read by eye from the downloaded files (zoomed where small); it is listed separately from page text.

coverage.storageCategory: 47 products over 4 pages: the same 14 SSDs plus HDDs, external HDDs (CTH2CSCA, CTH2DSCA), pen drives and microSD cards. No portable SSD.
coverage.siteSearch: "ssd" (44 results, 4 pages) found one more SSD outside the SSD category: post 2044, 2.5" 512GB ("Uncategorized"). "nvme" (17 results) and "portable" (19 results) found no further SSDs. "S7": no products.
coverage.images: 63 gallery images downloaded, all valid WebP (full size: 800-810 px wide, a few 541-558 px).

conventions.value fields: value = what the page TEXT states (title H1, description bullets/paragraphs). null when the page text does not state it OR states conflicting figures (see consistentOnPage / quotes / contradictions).
conventions.quotes: verbatim page text with location (title / description bullet n / description paragraph n); all quotes are checked against the saved HTML by tools/build_range.py.
conventions.statedInImages / imageQuotes / textInIma: what the official gallery images show; kept separate from page text.
conventions.price: null = no price/MRP shown on the official product page.
conventions.tbw: null everywhere: no TBW figure on any Consistent page.
conventions.images.role: drive = drive alone on a plain background; box = retail box alone; banner = marketing composite with spec text; lifestyle = drive in a scene / infographic; infographic = graphic without the drive.
conventions.images.background: measured on a 2% border ring: white / transparent / solid colour / mostly white / scene.
